text: Expose more claude-code-wrapper settings, including hooks and idle_auto_compact, as typed wrapper settings, not a raw config overlay.
Command hooks are allowed as well as http (webhook) hooks, with the env-exposure risk documented; user text rendered into the wrapper config is escaped ($$) against ${VAR} interpolation.
Optional leader lease timeout: at expiry leadership is handed to the longest-free agent at a turn boundary, never interrupting a running turn; handover only, no takeovers.
Optional autoclose after a time: counted from cluster creation, closes the cluster through the existing discard path, minimum 300 s.
Clusters gets its own page in the hamburger Settings list, above Presets.
Every capability gets a documented API and an API-only e2e test.
Releases, pin bumps and helmfile apply plus smoke are tasks of this epic.
The epic runs after agent-init-scripts, cluster-scaling and frontend-decoupling; its UI tasks land in the agents-web component, not in agent-orchestrator/frontend.
